asks: In what order is Silo built?
answer: The MVP comes first: settle the shared engine API, then build the Zig engine, the views-only Swift Mac app and the `silo` command over it, a Linux main on your Mac reached over SSH with browser sign-in, the outside network boundary with plain secret placeholder swapping and the append-only record, APFS copy-on-write disk checkpoints with restore and forks, outside file diffs between checkpoints, model calls read at the boundary, and receipts with copy and export for analysis by any agent. After MVP come tools inside computers, a macOS main, rules and held requests, non-swap secrets, classifiers, precautions, extensions, recipes and tasks, and the rest of the app. Speed and boundary discipline are part of the work from the start. `order.json` holds the exact order, and nothing in it has a date.
